about.subtitle: About Leks Company
about.title: Production capacity on a European scale
about.lead: We are a strategic and stable partner for the largest retail chains in Poland and Europe.
about.p1: From a small artisan bakery, we have transformed into a powerful producer with three specialized production plants in Sulęcin, Gorzów Wielkopolski, and Tarnów Bycki. Our factories hold prestigious IFS Food and BRC Global Standard certificates at the highest level, guaranteeing full safety and reliability of deliveries.
about.p2: Our logistics of freshness and advanced deferred baking technology (Bake-off) allow us to deliver crispy bread on time to thousands of stores every single day.
about.timeline_subtitle: Click on any point to learn our story

1989.title: Establishment in Sulęcin
1989.desc: Leks begins its activity as a small family bakery with a passion for traditional sourdough breads in Sulęcin.

1998.title: Production Capacity: 50,000 / day
1998.desc: Construction of the first fully automated plant in Sulęcin. Production capacity rises to 50,000 loaves per day, enabling strategic entry to the first regional retail chains.

2005.title: Implementation of IFS & BRC Standards
2005.desc: Construction of a modern plant in Gorzów Wielkopolski. Implementation of strict international IFS Food and BRC Global Standard certifications at Grade A level, opening doors to cooperation with nationwide and European supermarket chains.

2010.title: Automation & Expansion
2010.desc: Commissioning of a modern logistics and warehouse center in Sulęcin and implementation of advanced packaging management systems, guaranteeing error-free order fulfillment.

2018.title: Bake-off Leader & 1200+ Points
2018.desc: Implementation of pioneering deferred baking and deep freezing (Bake-off) lines. Our advanced logistics fleet ensures daily, punctual deliveries of fresh dough to over 1,200 supermarkets in Europe.

2026.title: Bakery of the Future & 2AB Line
2026.desc: Full production automation with the maintenance of the traditional 24-hour fermentation process. Implementation of a unique bread line from ancient 2AB wheat and transition of our plants to 100% sustainable renewable energy.

blog.subtitle: Knowledge & Insights
blog.title: Blog
blog.p1_desc: In 2026, bread quality is not just baking, it is also lightning-fast logistics.
blog.p1_content:
At LEKS Bakery, we know that a crispy crust and the aroma of fresh bread stem from precision logistics as much as great recipes. In 2026, we deliver bread to hundreds of locations in Poland and Western Europe in record time from oven extraction.

Refrigerated Fleet & Temperature Control

Every delivery vehicle features real-time temperature and humidity monitoring systems, ensuring optimal taste and nutrient preservation upon delivery.

Modified Atmosphere Packaging (MAP)

For flagship items like 2AB ancient grain bread, we utilize MAP technology to extend natural shelf life without chemical preservatives.

Logistics at LEKS is the bridge between artisan ovens and our consumers morning tables.
blog.p2_title: Bread in the Modern Consumer Diet
blog.p2_desc: Consumers seek products supporting health and natural immunity.
blog.p2_content:
Modern consumers pay close attention to food ingredients. Bread is now a core component of a balanced diet supporting digestion and immunity.

The Power of 2AB Ancient Grain

Our breakthrough is 2AB ancient wheat (Aegilops Tauschii & Speltoides), featuring a protein structure easily processed by human digestion.

Low Glycemic Index & Minerals

2AB bread boasts high zinc, selenium, and fiber content with a low GI for stable energy levels.

True health starts with grain that respects human metabolism.
blog.p3_title: From Grain to Loaf: Tradition Meets Technology
blog.p3_desc: How our modern bakeries preserve authentic taste.
blog.p3_content:
We combine multi-generational baking traditions with state-of-the-art technology to guarantee consistent high quality.

Long Sourdough Fermentation

Our living rye sourdough starter ferments over many hours to create deep aroma, crispy crust, and elastic crumb.

Computer-Controlled Tunnel Ovens

Automated tunnel ovens control steam and temperature distribution perfectly for traditional rustic flavor.

Technology does not replace the baker's heart – it protects traditional flavor.
blog.p4_title: Eco-Bakery: Our Road to 100% Green Energy
blog.p4_desc: In 2026, our production facilities transitioned fully to sustainable energy sources.
blog.p4_content:
Environmental stewardship is a core priority at LEKS. Our plants in Sulęcin and Gorzów achieved full energy self-sufficiency using renewables.

Photovoltaics & Oven Heat Recovery

Rooftop solar panels and oven waste heat recovery systems power our facilities and hot water supply.

100% Biodegradable Packaging

We reduced plastic use by 85% with recycled paper bags and compostable films.

A sustainable baker bakes with respect for both people and planet.

b2b.subtitle: Commercial Cooperation
b2b.title: Reliable B2B Partner with 35 Years of Experience
b2b.lead: Leks is not just a producer of traditional bread — we are a proven, scalable supplier with an international quality system. Active since 1989, we are now a bread supplier for the largest retail chains in Poland and Europe.
b2b.adv1_desc:
• 3 production plants: Sulęcin, Gorzów Wielkopolski, Tarnowo Byckie.
  • Production capacity ensuring steady supply even for the largest clients.
  • Logistics covering all of Europe — export-ready.
b2b.adv2_desc:
• ISO 22000:2018 certificate — proof of systematic food safety management.
  • IFS Food version 8 (Higher Level) certificate with a score of 97.73% — the standard required by retail chains in Europe.
  • Regular audits, including unannounced ones — a guarantee of continuous quality control.
b2b.adv3_desc:
• Long-term cooperation with the largest retail chains in Poland and Europe.
  • Assortment flexibility: 300 products, including fresh and deep-frozen bread (Bake-off), pastry products.
b2b.adv4_desc:
• Clean label: The end customer looks for honest bread — we produce it.
  • Customization: Ability to adapt composition and packaging to private label requirements.
b2b.process_lead: We have the production and logistics facilities to meet the requirements of the largest buyers in Europe.
b2b.pillar1_desc: Fully automated baking lines guaranteeing consistency and maximum efficiency.
b2b.pillar2_desc: Strict monitoring at every stage of production from raw material to finished product (HACCP, IFS, ISO).
b2b.pillar3_desc: Modern cold stores, high-bay warehouses, and a specialized transport fleet.
